Trs.

MOO_KitchenGnoll
'Timothy' is a gnoll who works in the kitchen in Moonrise Towers during Act Two.
“
Clean up your mess, Timothy. That gnome was not for eating.
„
— Linsella, to 'Timothy'

Involvement

Act Two

'Timothy' and his fellow gnolls,  'Barnabus' and  'Tomelia', work in Moonrise Towers' kitchens under  Linsella, being trained against their vicious nature to speak and behave courteously. The party can free them from her thrall by succeeding a  DC 16 Wisdom Check.

If the gnolls are freed from their mental servitude, they ally with the party during the assault on Moonrise Towers.
